newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore morning shares steady, block deals seen.
newsitem.headline: Singapore morning shares steady, block deals seen.

text.p: The Singapore stock market held steady in quiet mid-morning trade on Friday with block deals dominating the actives, dealers said.

"The market is quiet. Most of the actives are block deals," one dealer said. Another added that the market was waiting to see if Malaysia would spring any surprises in its budget announcements later on Friday.
At 0215 GMT, the key Straits Times Industrials Index was up 19.02 points at 2,078.63. Turnover was light, around 30 million.
Small capitalised stocks dominated the actives for the fifth consecutive day this week but many included block deals.

Dealers said Venture, which topped the actives, saw 7.4 million shares crossed at S$2.55 (US$1.80). Uraco Holdings saw 2.9 million of its 3.2 million crossed at S$0.836 while Kemayan saw 1.0 million of its 1.06 million crossed at S$2.00.
Blue-chips Fraser & Neave and Singapore Press Foreign led gainers, rising S$0.40 each to S$14.10 and S$24.60 respectively.
Kulim Bhd and Jardine Matheson led losers, shedding S$0.15 and US$0.15 respectively to S$2.87 and US$5.65.
